StudentProfile.title: StudentProfile
StudentProfile.description: Student contact and hostel delivery profile owned by the authenticated user.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the student.

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

Shop.title: Shop
Shop.description: Nearby local shop registered by a shopkeeper for hyperlocal hostel ordering.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the shopkeeper who owns this shop.

mobile.description: 10-digit shopkeeper mobile number for call inquiries.

distance.description: Walking distance from hostel gate (1-30 chars).

shopOpen.description: Whether the shop is currently open for incoming orders.

listed.description: Whether the shop is actively listed in the campus directory.

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

Order.title: Order
Order.description: Hyperlocal student order (quick items, text note, and/or audio voice note) routed to a specific shop or broadcast to all open shops.

studentUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the student who placed the order.

studentName.description: Student name snapshot at order time.

studentMobile.description: Student 10-digit mobile number for shopkeeper call inquiry.

orderMode.description: COMMON broadcasts to all open shops; DIRECT targets one shop.

broadcastOpen.description: True only while a COMMON order is still PENDING so shopkeepers can query the open pool.

deliveryMode.description: Hostel gate delivery or shop self-pickup.

pickupPin.description: 4-digit verification PIN shown to student and shopkeeper.

itemsSummary.description: Bounded list (max 30) of formatted item lines ordered from the quick grid.

customNote.description: Optional text list or instructions typed by the student (0-500 chars).

voiceNoteBase64.description: Optional AMR-NB audio voice note encoded as Base64 (0-300000 chars).

voiceNoteDurationSec.description: Recorded voice note duration in seconds (0-60).

targetShopId.description: Shop document ID for DIRECT orders; empty string for COMMON.

targetShopName.description: Shop name for DIRECT orders; empty string for COMMON.

targetShopOwnerId.description: Shop owner UID for DIRECT orders; empty string for COMMON.

acceptedShopId.description: Document ID of the shop that accepted the order.

acceptedShopMobile.description: 10-digit mobile number of the accepting shop.

acceptedShopOwnerId.description: Owner UID of the accepting shop.

acceptedShopDistance.description: Distance label of the accepting shop.

skippedShopIds.description: Bounded list (max 50) of shop IDs that skipped a COMMON order.

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/students/{studentId}.description: Per-user student delivery profile keyed by auth UID.

/shops/{shopId}.description: Nearby shops registered by local shopkeepers.

/orders/{orderId}.description: Real-time student orders supporting direct shop targeting and common open-shop broadcasts.
